extension.description: Send code snippets and messages to your Maestri agents.
command.compose: Write to an agent (in the editor)
view.agents.name: Agents
view.agents.welcome:
Connect this VS Code to Maestri to see your agents live.
[Pair with Maestri](command:maestriBridge.pair)
config.gutterButton.description: Shows the + button in the editor margin to write to a Maestri agent.
config.notifyAttention.description: Notifies you when a Maestri agent starts asking for attention.
config.pollIntervalSeconds.description: Interval, in seconds, to refresh the agents while VS Code is focused.
config.language.description: Extension language. Command and menu names always follow the VS Code language.
config.agentLinks.description: Lets agents open files here, highlight code and leave notes you can reply to. Only files inside the open folders are opened.
